claims.name: card-snapshot-imported-as-converted-text
claims.risk: the card was never imported as converted markdown, so a later read cannot show what changed

claims.name: snapshot-holds-the-card
claims.risk: the snapshot leaves out a field, a comment, a link or the attachment of the card, or the updated time

claims.name: card-not-written
claims.risk: the saved card was edited: its description or status was changed, or a changed copy of it was kept

claims.name: progress-drafted-as-one-comment
claims.risk: the progress is not in one draft comment for the person to post, or is split into a comment for each requirement
